name: Affiliate Lifestyle

steps.title: Không gian

lifestyle_intro.name: Mở đầu
lifestyle_intro.prompt_template: {avatar_description} in a beautiful {space_description}, relaxed and welcoming. Natural warm lighting. Lifestyle content, inviting atmosphere.
